Name: Tibni, King of Israel
Summary: Tibni, son of Ginath, was set up by half of Israel against Omri after Zimri's death, and after a divided struggle he died and Omri prevailed.
RelatedPeople: Omri, King of Israel; Ginath, Father of Tibni
LifeLesson: A divided people cannot stand, and a rival crown is no crown at all.
